description: This file defines the 'testsuite' class, which provides CRUD operations, hierarchical tree management, custom fields, keyword management, export functionality, and attachment handling for test suite entities within the TestLink testing framework. It interacts with database tables and other classes like 'tree', 'cfield_mgr', and 'attachmentRepository' to manage test suite related data.

classes.name: testsuite
classes.description: The 'testsuite' class manages test suite entities including creation, update, deletion, hierarchy, keywords, custom fields, attachments, and data export for the TestLink framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the testsuite object with database connection and sets up tree management, custom fields, and object table references.

methods.name: get_export_file_types
methods.description: Returns supported export file types.

methods.name: get_import_file_types
methods.description: Returns supported import file types.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new test suite under a parent with specified name and details, with optional duplicate name handling.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the attributes (name, details, order) of an existing test suite.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a test suite and associated test cases, attachments, and keywords.

methods.name: get_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves test suite(s) matching a given name.

methods.name: get_by_id
methods.description: Fetches detailed information of a test suite by its ID.

methods.name: get_all
methods.description: Retrieves list of all test suites.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays test suite data via a Smarty template, including attachments and custom fields.

methods.name: viewer_edit_new
methods.description: Provides UI for creating or editing a test suite with support for templates and rich editors.

methods.name: copy_to
methods.description: Performs deep copying of a test suite, including its children, attachments, keywords, and custom fields.

methods.name: get_subtree
methods.description: Retrieves a subtree of test suites and test cases rooted at a given test suite ID.

methods.name: get_testcases_deep
methods.description: Fetches all test cases within a test suite and its children, with varying detail levels.

methods.name: get_children_testcases
methods.description: Gets immediate test case children of a test suite.

methods.name: delete_deep
methods.description: Deletes a test suite and all its descendants.

methods.name: _initializeWebEditors
methods.description: Initializes web editors based on templates for creating or editing test suites.

methods.name: getKeywords
methods.description: Retrieves keywords assigned to a test suite.

methods.name: get_keywords_map
methods.description: Returns a map of keyword IDs to keywords for a test suite.

methods.name: addKeyword
methods.description: Links a keyword to a test suite.

methods.name: addKeywords
methods.description: Associates multiple keywords to a test suite.

methods.name: deleteKeywords
methods.description: Removes keyword(s) from a test suite.

methods.name: exportTestSuiteDataToXML
methods.description: Exports test suite data, including nested test cases and attachments, to XML format.

methods.name: get_linked_cfields_at_design
methods.description: Retrieves linked custom fields for a test suite at design time.

methods.name: getTestProjectFromTestSuite
methods.description: Gets the test project ID that a test suite belongs to.

methods.name: get_linked_cfields_at_execution
methods.description: Retrieves linked custom fields for a test suite at execution time.

methods.name: html_table_of_custom_field_inputs
methods.description: Generates HTML for custom field input controls in test suite UI.

methods.name: html_table_of_custom_field_values
methods.description: Generates HTML table displaying custom field values for a test suite.

methods.name: copy_attachments
methods.description: Copies attachments from source to target test suite.

methods.name: copy_keyword_assignment
methods.description: Copies keyword assignments from one test suite to another.

methods.name: copy_cfields_values
methods.description: Copies custom field values from source to target test suite.

methods.name: get_children
methods.description: Retrieves immediate child test suites or test cases.

methods.name: get_branch
methods.description: Gets a branch (subtree) of test suites starting from root.

methods.name: createFromObject
methods.description: Creates a test suite from a data object with validation.

methods.name: checkNameExistence
methods.description: Checks if a test suite name exists at the same hierarchy level.

methods.name: getFileUploadRelativeURL
methods.description: Provides URL for uploading files to a test suite.

methods.name: getDeleteAttachmentRelativeURL
methods.description: Provides URL for deleting attachments from a test suite.

methods.name: renderImageAttachments
methods.description: Renders inline image attachments within test suite data.

methods.name: updateDetails
methods.description: Updates detailed description/content of a test suite.

methods.name: inlineImageProcessing
methods.description: Processes and replaces inline image references within test suite details.

methods.name: buildDirectWebLink
methods.description: Constructs a direct web link to a test suite.

methods.name: getChildrenLatestTCVersion
methods.description: Fetches latest versions of test cases directly under a test suite.

methods.name: getTSuitesFilteredByKWSet
methods.description: Retrieves test suites filtered by keyword criteria.

methods.name: getFreeKeywords
methods.description: Lists keywords not yet assigned to a test suite, for possible addition.

methods.name: getTestproject
methods.description: Returns the ID of the parent test project for a given test suite.

methods.name: deleteKeywordByLinkID
methods.description: Deletes a keyword link by its association ID.

methods.name: addKeywordsDeep
methods.description: Adds multiple keywords to a test suite and all its descendants.

methods.name: getKeywordsForTSSet
methods.description: Retrieves keywords assigned across a set of test suites.

methods.name: keywordIsLinked
methods.description: Checks if a keyword is linked to a test suite.
